data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Google Performance Monitoring for Firebase.
data.what_it_does: Monitors traces and HTTP/S network requests on Android, iOS, and Web. Integrates Google Performance Monitoring for Firebase into your Flutter application.
use_when: You are already using Firebase in your Flutter app and want to track performance metrics.
You need to monitor custom traces and network request durations.
avoid_when: You are not using Firebase services in your application.
You require an offline-only analytics and performance monitoring solution.
strengths: Official Firebase plugin maintained by the FlutterFire team.
Supports Android, iOS, and Web platforms.
weaknesses: Requires a Firebase project setup and proper initialization of firebase_core.
data.setup_notes: Requires configuring Firebase for your platforms and initializing firebase_core, along with adding the Firebase Performance SDK.
data.minimal_example:
import 'package:firebase_performance/firebase_performance.||

// Usage details can be found in the official documentation
